method: Each case run with the skill active vs a no-skill baseline; strict per-assertion grading with quoted evidence (agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills).

cases.name: noisy-export-collapse-to-signal
cases.headline: With-skill passes all 4; baseline matches on 3 but misses the dedup-by-trace tooling/funnel approach (no triage-logs.sh or repeatable trace-collapse query).

cases.name: gke-archetype-targeting
cases.headline: Both answers nail resource type, logName/project, and severity floor (3/4); neither covers the GKE trace-correlation note, so no with-vs-baseline delta on this prompt.

cases.name: secret-leak-apikey
cases.headline: With-skill passes all 4; baseline misses only the --format projection assertion, instead masking in the logger and querying without a safe-field projection.

cases.name: exclusion-filter-safety
cases.headline: With-skill answer leads with non-retroactivity/unrecoverability warning and pushes emitter-fix/sampling before a blanket drop (4/4); baseline gives a correct _Default command with caveats but never warns entries are unrecoverable and treats the full exclusion as the default move with sampling only as an afterthought (2/4).

cases.name: defer-rootcause-to-sibling
cases.headline: With-skill cleanly hands deep root-cause-to-code off to error-trace-rootcause by name (3/3); baseline names no sibling skill and absorbs the code-mapping job itself (0/3).

cases.name: defer-ranking-to-sibling
cases.headline: With-skill hands the ranking off to Error Reporting by name and treats raw logs only as a sanity check, while baseline builds a full raw-log aggregation of both occurrence and affected-user counts — though both technically still derive a group ranking from raw logs.

cases.name: cloudrun-logname-encoding
cases.headline: Both answers fully satisfy all 3 assertions (cloud_run_revision + service_name, %2Fstderr logName, severity>=ERROR); no delta on the graded criteria, though the with-skill answer adds a security note about avoiding the authorization-bearer header blob.

cases.name: overtrigger-control-instrumentation
cases.headline: With-skill correctly recognizes overtrigger and hands off to app-side logging guidance (3/3); baseline answers the out-of-scope authoring question in full, failing both scope assertions (1/3).

known_flaws.missed_assertion: Notes that GKE k8s_container has no top-level GCP trace, so request correlation uses jsonPayload.traceId/contextId (not trace=)
Does not attempt to compute group rankings or affected-user counts from raw log queries
